## I lost track

| Type | What it does |
|---|---|
| `where` or `/mycelium-extra:where` | Show a short ADHD-format card for one analysis, with its aim, state, next action and approach. |
| `focus <folder>` | Explain the typed focus command and list the folders a focus can name. |
| `/mycelium-extra:re-pitch` | Re-pitch your last message in short plain sentences when the user lost the thread, with no claim weakened and the decisions numbered at the end. |
| `/mycelium-extra:handoff` | Write a short HANDOFF.md so a fresh session can resume from one small file. |
| `/mycelium-extra:handoff-resume` | Hand off, restart and resume in one chain; hooks check each link and the next session reads HANDOFF.md first. |

## I am starting something

| Type | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/mycelium-extra:new-analysis` | Scaffold a new analysis folder for Mycelium (code stubs, plot theme, plan, Snakefile, run.sh; one overwritten output folder per script). |
| `/mycelium-extra:grill` | Planning: turn a research, analysis, or software task into a sourced step-by-step plan and wait for approval (unless the gate is off). |
| `/mycelium-extra:analysis-map` | Chart a research program too big for one session as a map of decision tickets, then resolve them one at a time. |
| `/mycelium-extra:research-note` | Delegate a sourced question to a background agent that writes one cited note while you keep working. |
| `/mycelium-extra:glossary` | Sharpen an analysis's terms while grilling, keep its GLOSSARY.md, and log each exploratory loop in ITERATIONS.md when there is no clear metric. |
| `/mycelium-extra:questionnaire` | Turn questions only someone else can answer (a PI, core facility or collaborator) into a Markdown questionnaire to send them. |
| `/mycelium-extra:setup-wizard` | Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks you through cluster setup steps only you can do. |
| `/mycelium-extra:repo-setup` | Set up a new repository in one pass, as a Mycelium analysis repo or a Python package, then the lucid-coder style and environment pointer. |
| `/mycelium-extra:init` | Turn on the plan-approval gate in this repository (creates .mycelium-extra/gate.json). |
| `/mycelium-extra:idea-triage` | Rank the ideas parked in todo/ so the user can choose the next one. |
